get_next_skill: get the next high-level skill and action arguments for a batch of environments using the planner policy
get_plan: get the shortest sequence of PDDL actions to reach a specified goal from the current predicate state
get_solution_nodes: perform BFS search to find all PlanNodes that satisfy a given PDDL goal from the current state
replan: recompute the plan for an environment by selecting a goal and generating the shortest action sequence
apply_mask: set the replanning flags for all environments based on whether the planner is reactive or not
